title: 1978 AHSME Problem 8
statement: If \(x\ne y\) and the sequences \(x,\) \(a_1,\) \(a_2,\) \(y\) and \(x,\) \(b_1,\) \(b_2,\) \(b_3,\) \(y\) each are in arithmetic progression, then \(\frac{a_2-a_1}{b_2-b_1}\) equals

solutions.text:
The first common difference is \(\frac{y-x}{3},\) and the second is \(\frac{y-x}{4}.\) Since \(x\ne y,\) their ratio is \[ \frac{\frac{y-x}{3}}{\frac{y-x}{4}}=\frac43. \]

Therefore, the correct answer is D.
